[TASK: ARCHITECTURAL RELIGHTING & STATIC RECONSTRUCTION]
Transform the reference photogrammetry plate into a razor-sharp, photorealistic architectural image.
Keep the reference plate's exact composition: every edge, horizon line, and object position stays where it is.

MANDATORY TRANSFORMATION RULES:
1. PLANAR RECTIFICATION & GEOMETRY LOCK: Treat the reference image as an immutable spatial coordinate frame. Eliminate all 3D mesh polygon wobble, melted facades, and distorted rooflines. Plumb all vertical walls to true gravity vertical. Render the specific materials, coursing, window types, and roof forms named in the SCENE section below with sharp, correct detail.
2. STATIC DECLUTTERING (MANDATORY): COMPLETELY ERASE all transient vehicles, parked cars, delivery vans, pedestrians, and temporary street clutter from the seed image. Repaint the ground plane with the authentic surfacing, kerbs, and pavement named in the SCENE section below.
3. BOTANICAL PHENOLOGY & CANOPY INTEGRITY: Overwrite all raw 3D mesh blob foliage with authentic seasonal canopy structures matching the target date. Zero green summer foliage during dormant/autumn/winter periods:
   *Acer pseudoplatanus*: Leafless; stout bare branches exposed with green dormant buds, rare persistent dry samaras.
*Tilia × europaea*: Leafless; dense twiggy crown visible with reddish winter buds and basal epicormic shoots.
*Ulmus glabra*: Leafless; coarse bare zig-zag branching structure exposed with dark dormant flower buds.
4. OPTICAL DEPTH: Sharp focus across the entire frame, near to far. No blur, no depth-of-field falloff, no vignetting.

[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING (SNOW):
Snowfall under a heavy overcast sky. The sun is not visible and casts no shadow anywhere in the scene. Snow lying evenly on every horizontal surface: roofs, ledges, sills, steps, kerbs, branches, and ground. Flat bright ambient light bouncing off the snow, very low contrast, cold blue-grey shadowless tone.
- SHADOW OVERWRITE RULE: MANDATORY: Erase every cast shadow present in the reference plate. The reference plate was captured in direct sun; this scene has none. Render all previously shadowed ground and facades as evenly lit under snow conditions, with no directional shadow anywhere.

[SCENE GEOMETRY & AUTHENTIC LITHICS]
Ainslie Place, Edinburgh. Central oval pleasure garden enclosed by curving Georgian ashlar terraces. Facades constructed from finely dressed Craigleith buff sandstone, featuring channeled rustication at ground floor, polished ashlar upper floors, molded string courses, dentiled entablature, and stone blocking parapets. Regular fenestration of rectangular timber sash-and-case windows in 6-over-6 configurations. Pitched roofs surfaced in Scottish Ballachulish blue-grey slate with lead flashings, ashlar chimney stacks with cylindrical terracotta pots, and timber-framed dormers. Sunken basement lightwells bordered by spearhead cast-iron railings. In the far background, a prominent Neoclassical drum and ribbed verdigris copper dome. Foreground dominated by circular park turf with curving compacted gravel paths, bounded by mature specimen trees including Acer pseudoplatanus, Tilia × europaea, and Ulmus glabra with massive upright trunks and broad branching canopy volumes. Perimeters defined by tooled Scottish whinstone kerbstones, asphalt road surface, and historic cast-iron streetlamps. Ashlar masonry displays authentic urban patina with stable dark gypsum coal-smoke encrustations concentrated in sheltered cornice recesses and rain-washed stone fields. Strictly static architectural survey without people, vehicles, or transient clutter.
